items.title: [bug] CachedTokenValidator has no SingleFlight: thundering herd on admin_db at the TTL boundary
items.summary:
### What's broken?

`broker/core/token_validation.py` `CachedTokenValidator` caches a validated token for `cache_ttl_seconds` (3 s). When the entry expires, **every** in-flight request carrying that token misses at once and each issues its own admin_db lookup. Under load with one hot agent token this is a periodic burst of N identical queries every 3 s. The rule evaluator and credential deriver already coalesce through `SingleFlight`; the token validator doesn't.

Expected: one in-flight refresh

items.title: [bug] RetryRunner never status-retries keyed POSTs: Idempotency-Key is stripped before _is_idempotent checks it
items.summary:

`RetryRunner` (`broker/adapters/runners/retry.py`) only retries a post-send status failure (429/5xx) when the request is idempotent: `_is_idempotent` checks the method, **or** an `idempotency-key` header on the `RunnerRequest`. But `forward_headers` (`broker/core/proxy_headers.py`) drops every header in `BROKER_CONSUMED_HEADERS` (`broker/core/headers.py`), which includes `idempotency-key`, before the runner request is built. items.summary:
I'm building a web app with FastAPI + async/await Python backend. Users upload leaf photos via API and the server should return: 1) plant species, 2) disease label or "healthy".

Constraints:

  1. Generalization: Must handle multiple crops. Users can upload "any" plant leaf, not just tomato/corn. Target 15+ species.

  2. Server inference: Runs on GPU server, not mobile. Latency 1-2s is acceptable, so model size isn't a bottleneck.
